summary: Practise AI inventory, risk classification, and audit-ready documentation. Explore role-based EU AI Act training for your organization.
lede: AI Act compliance training helps compliance, legal, HR, IT, procurement, and business teams assess AI use cases and organize evidence for applicable obligations. Participants practise building AI inventories, classifying use cases by risk, screening prohibited practices, and documenting transparency, oversight, and high-risk controls. They also develop an AI literacy action plan and an internal compliance programme outline, including role-based responsibilities and supplier evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, procure, oversee, or use AI systems that may fall within the EU AI Act’s scope. Each role examines the responsibilities and evidence relevant to its work.
modules: EU AI Act Scope and Roles
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational AI use cases, procurement, compliance, legal review, or technology governance is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to spreadsheet software for inventory and evidence exercises; no specific vendor platform is required.
